text: Skip to main content About Publication 502, Medical and Dental Expenses More In Forms and Instructions Current year Prior year Accessible eBooks Browser-friendly forms and publications Mobile-friendly forms Post release changes to forms Order forms and publications Help with forms and instructions Comment on tax forms and publications Publication 502 explains the itemized deduction for medical and dental expenses that you claim on Schedule A (Form 1040), including: What expenses, and whose expenses, you can and cannot include in figuring the deduction. How to treat reimbursements and how to figure the deduction. How to report the deduction on your tax return and what to do if you sell medical property or receive damages for a personal injury.
